summary: Executed live API + Expo web integration testing against https://api.neksathi.in and preview frontend. Backend parity tests passed; core mobile-web flows mostly work (login, session restore, vehicle create/edit, QR copy/share UI, scan own QR to vehicle-detail, permissions screen, tab regression, logout/relogin). Found startup resilience simulation and tag-type selector issues.

ui_bugs.issue: SIMULATED /api/auth/me 500 during reload did not surface startup-error-screen; app landed on login screen instead.
Tag type selector was not opening option modal reliably in overlay flow; observed 0 selectable options and close control not rendered.

integration_issues.issue: SIMULATED 500 and malformed /auth/me did not consistently route to startup retry UI in browser automation; session dropped to login path.

action_items: Fix startup simulation path so SIMULATED /auth/me 500/malformed responses render startup-error-screen + retry instead of login fallback.
Fix tag-type-select interaction/data loading in New Tag overlay; ensure server enum options render and are selectable.
Re-run SIMULATED startup resilience matrix (500/timeout/malformed/401) after fix.
Device-dependent pending: native permission popup behavior, Settings resume behavior, notification tap/resume, fresh Android install/restart remain unverified in this environment.
critical_code_review_comments: Expo runtime repeatedly logs dependency compatibility warnings (expo / expo-constants mismatch); not a blocker in this run but should be stabilized.
Startup resilience depends on /auth/me bootstrap correctness; observed behavior under intercepted errors is inconsistent with intended startup retry UX.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST vehicle via UI: number plate MH12AB1077; backend pytest created and then attempted cleanup for its own vehicle records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Credentials file present and valid (demo@neksathi.app/demo1234). For scan own-QR validation, known demo QR used: cd85b7e5-a36b-44d0-8c9c-556c33db0330. Use security-scan-qr button path (direct page.goto('/scan') and page.goto('/scan-report?...') were inconsistent in this Expo web harness).
rca_of_issue: Likely RCA for startup simulation miss: during intercepted /auth/me failure runs, bootstrap state did not persist token path consistently in browser automation, causing login route instead of startup-error-state. This may indicate a race between secure token persistence/read on web AsyncStorage and bootstrap route guard under forced network interception.
